items.title: Denny Zeitlin interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

ctx.x: Well I’ll throw a couple of words or phrases at you, and see if they have any reaction. Duke Ellington?

I love the Duke’s music. When I grew up though in terms of emotionally I was more drawn to Count Basie’s band. And there was something about the rhythmic unison feeling of that band, it was like one pulsing organism, that emotionally got to me even more than Duke’s band and Duke’s writing, although unquestionably he’s one of the towering geniuses of the music, clearly.
